runs.question: Which OMB memo currently governs how federal agencies acquire AI, and what happened to the earlier acquisition memo?

answer.text:
OMB Memorandum M-25-22, "Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government," dated April 3, 2025, is the memo that governs. It was issued April 3, 2025. It provides guidance to agencies to improve their ability to acquire AI responsibly.

The earlier acquisition memo was M-24-18, "Advancing the Responsible Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government," dated September 24, 2024. M-25-22 rescinds and replaces OMB Memorandum M-24-18.

The passages do not say anything further about which specific M-24-18 requirements were kept, changed, or dropped. They only state the rescission and replacement.
